First public build.

- Expression engine with correct operator precedence and real-time results
- Scientific functions including the full hyperbolic set and their inverses
- RAD and DEG angle modes, plus built-in π and e
- Three keypad layouts, with a spreadsheet-style editor for custom ones
- Material 3 dynamic theming with seven scheme styles, or a seed color you pick
- Wallpaper-derived colours on Android 12+
- Expression history, tap to recall
- Configurable decimal separator and E-notation behaviour
